description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements logging functionality by wrapping Android's native Log utility within a custom Logger interface. It manages chaining of log nodes and formats log messages, including exceptions, before delegating to Android's Log methods.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, enabling flexible chaining of log nodes and formatting of log messages.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to which log messages will be passed.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable. Formats the message and exception (if present), writes to Android log, and propagates to the next node if available.
